scope: Ordinary changed-code CI only. Zero candidates produce N/A, never 100% or an invented baseline. The complete frozen mutation campaign is unchanged and remains pending.

original_failure.reason: Empty formatting-aware diff: cargo-mutants returned before writing outcomes.json; the separate scoring step tried to open that absent report.

contracts: Candidate selection records base/head, command, raw stdout/stderr, version, diff hash and candidate hash
N/A requires successful valid JSON[] or one complete known INFO message from cargo-mutants 27.1.0 in diff mode; any extra diagnostic rejects
Real parser tests cover empty diff, a diff without Rust source and a diff outside production functions
Full mode applies no diff and requires JSON; nonempty selections must match all outcome identities and use the unchanged quality gate
Missing/incomplete results, baseline failure, survivors, timeouts and cargo errors fail
